rows.note: Use 黃色 as the all-purpose noun for the color yellow.

example.jyutping: ning4 mung1 tung1 soeng4 hai6 wong4 sik1 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the color yellow.

example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 hai6 wong4 sik1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for someone who lacks courage or acts cowardly.

example.english: They are so yellow that they are even afraid of little dogs.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 daam2 siu2 lin4 gau2 zai2 dou1 geng1

rows.note: Use this for reporting or content that is lurid, emotionally manipulative, or sensationalist.

example.english: This report is too yellow and makes people think the whole thing is extremely serious.
example.traditional: 呢篇報道太煽情，搞到人以為成件事好嚴重。
example.jyutping: nei1 pin1 bou3 dou6 taai3 sin3 cing4 gaau2 dou3 jan4 ji5 wai4 sing4 gin6 si6 hou2 jim4 zung6
